MagicSword.title: Magic Weapon
MagicSword.intro: Add {name} as it is, or attach one additional modifier (opponent bonus or talent — not both). Optionally mark it cursed.
MagicSword.cursedDescription: Cursed. Magical bonuses are penalties. The wielder cannot willingly discard it once used in battle (unequip blocked for non-GM). Compulsion to always use it in battle is manual. Remove curse / dispel evil may lift the compulsion or restore the weapon per RC.

MagicArmor.title: Magic Armor
MagicArmor.intro: Add {name} as it is, or attach one special power.
